name: animated-shorts-project
description: Ready-to-run Remotion + three.js project for the cartoon-3d-short skill

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts BridgeShort out/bridge/video.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --gl=angle
scripts.render:cloud: remotion render src/index.ts BridgeShort out/bridge/video.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --gl=swangle --timeout=300000 --concurrency=2
scripts.render:2k: remotion render src/index.ts BridgeShort out/bridge/video.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --gl=angle --scale 1.3333
scripts.render:trojan: remotion render src/index.ts TrojanShort out/trojan.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --gl=swangle --timeout=300000 --concurrency=2
